sections.intake-window: Clients must upload requested documents within 5 business days of receiving the intake link. An assigned specialist follows up on incomplete uploads.
sections.expense-review: Expenses above $650 require a second review before the case can move to preparation. An original receipt must be retained.
sections.accepted-files: Accepted upload formats are PDF, PNG, and JPG. Maximum file size is 15 MB per file.
sections.handoff: A named case owner is required before an intake packet moves to preparation. After the handoff, a specialist must ask for a second reviewer on cases flagged high risk.
